public JobStateInternal transition(JobImpl job, JobEvent event) {
  job.metrics.submittedJob(job);
  job.metrics.preparingJob(job);

  if (job.newApiCommitter) {
    job.jobContext = new JobContextImpl(job.conf, job.oldJobId);
  } else {
    job.jobContext = new org.apache.hadoop.mapred.JobContextImpl(job.conf, job.oldJobId);
  }

  try {
    setupJob(job);
    job.fs = job.getFileSystem(job.conf);

    JobSubmittedEvent jse = createJobSubmittedEvent(job);
    job.eventHandler.handle(new JobHistoryEvent(job.jobId, jse));

    TaskSplitMetaInfo[] taskSplitMetaInfo = readSplits(job, job.jobId);
    job.numMapTasks = taskSplitMetaInfo.length;
    job.numReduceTasks = job.conf.getInt(MRJobConfig.NUM_REDUCES, 0);

    setTaskWeights(job);

    checkTaskLimits(job);

    long inputLength = calculateInputLength(taskSplitMetaInfo);
    decideUber(job, inputLength);

    initializeTaskLists(job);

    job.allowedMapFailuresPercent = job.conf.getInt(MRJobConfig.MAP_FAILURES_MAX_PERCENT, 0);
    job.allowedReduceFailuresPercent = job.conf.getInt(MRJobConfig.REDUCE_FAILURES_MAXPERCENT, 0);

    createMapTasks(job, inputLength, taskSplitMetaInfo);
    createReduceTasks(job);

    job.metrics.endPreparingJob(job);
    return JobStateInternal.INITED;
  } catch (Exception e) {
    LOG.warn("Job init failed", e);
    job.metrics.endPreparingJob(job);
    job.addDiagnostic("Job init failed : " + StringUtils.stringifyException(e));
    return JobStateInternal.NEW;
  }
}

private synchronized void setupConnection() throws IOException {
  short ioFailures = 0;
  short timeoutFailures = 0;
  while (true) {
    try {
      establishSocket();
      return;
    } catch (ConnectTimeoutException toe) {

        timeoutFailures = ioFailures = 0;
      }
      handleConnectionTimeout(timeoutFailures++, maxRetriesOnSocketTimeouts, toe);

      if (updateAddress()) {
        timeoutFailures = ioFailures = 0;
      }
      handleConnectionFailure(ioFailures++, ie);

private void establishSocket() throws IOException {
  this.socket = socketFactory.createSocket();
  this.socket.setTcpNoDelay(tcpNoDelay);
  this.socket.setKeepAlive(true);

  // Bind to local address if Kerberos credentials present
  UserGroupInformation ticket = remoteId.getTicket();
  if (ticket != null && ticket.hasKerberosCredentials()) {
    KerberosInfo krbInfo = remoteId.getProtocol().getAnnotation(KerberosInfo.class);
    if (krbInfo != null && krbInfo.clientPrincipal() != null) {
      String host = SecurityUtil.getHostFromPrincipal(remoteId.getTicket().getUserName());
      InetAddress localAddr = NetUtils.getLocalInetAddress(host);
      if (localAddr != null) {
        this.socket.bind(new InetSocketAddress(localAddr, 0));
      }
    }
  }

  NetUtils.connect(this.socket, server, connectionTimeout);
  if (rpcTimeout > 0) {
    pingInterval = rpcTimeout;  // rpcTimeout overwrites pingInterval
  }
  this.socket.setSoTimeout(pingInterval);
}

private void setupConnection() throws IOException {
  short ioFailures = 0;
  short timeoutFailures = 0;
  while (true) {
    try {
      createAndConnectSocket();
      return;
    } catch (ConnectTimeoutException toe) {
      if (updateAddress()) {
        timeoutFailures = ioFailures = 0;
      }
      handleConnectionTimeout(timeoutFailures++, maxRetriesOnSocketTimeouts, toe);
    } catch (IOException ie) {
      if (updateAddress()) {
        timeoutFailures = ioFailures = 0;
      }
      handleConnectionFailure(ioFailures++, ie);
    }
  }
}

private void createAndConnectSocket() throws IOException {
  this.socket = socketFactory.createSocket();
  this.socket.setTcpNoDelay(tcpNoDelay);
  this.socket.setKeepAlive(true);
  bindSocketToKerberosHostIfNeeded();
  NetUtils.connect(this.socket, server, connectionTimeout);
  if (rpcTimeout > 0) {
    pingInterval = rpcTimeout;
  }
  this.socket.setSoTimeout(pingInterval);
}

private void bindSocketToKerberosHostIfNeeded() throws IOException {
  UserGroupInformation ticket = remoteId.getTicket();
  if (ticket != null && ticket.hasKerberosCredentials()) {
    KerberosInfo krbInfo = remoteId.getProtocol().getAnnotation(KerberosInfo.class);
    if (krbInfo != null && krbInfo.clientPrincipal() != null) {
      String host = SecurityUtil.getHostFromPrincipal(remoteId.getTicket().getUserName());
      InetAddress localAddr = NetUtils.getLocalInetAddress(host);
      if (localAddr != null) {
        this.socket.bind(new InetSocketAddress(localAddr, 0));
      }
    }
  }
}
